constructionRule: When adjacentSizeRatioMax is supplied, the hole-front constructor derives its row-height growth so an ideal aligned strip does not request a longest connecting edge above the retained adjacency limit.
acceptanceRule: The actual generated child must still independently satisfy measured ADJACENT_SIZE_RATIO <= 1.5; this construction rule is not acceptance evidence.
legacyCompatibility: Callers that omit adjacentSizeRatioMax retain the existing 1.6 activation/growth heuristic.
